notes: All checkable visual claims match the renders; no contradictions. Two claims are not checkable because the relevant content is hidden in the canonical renders (list behind the filter panel; the 上门费 card below the fold). Side notes, not scored as claims: NOTES lists specific ratios all >= 5.0, while facts report a lowest measured ratio of 4.91 (still AA), so some text sits below the listed ratios, probably grey text on the grey page background; NOTES says the smallest type is 12 px apart from the 10 px tab bar, but the source has an 11 px rule (the filter count badge), which cannot be measured from the render.
